paradigm_claim: reward learning for calibrated typed decisions over world-state factorized (WSFT) targets; user-mandated benchmark: Calibrated Typed Decisions via Reward Learning, combined with predicate-factorized targets and permutation-group consistency — no precedent found for this combination (frontier report I1 novelty + this slice's coupling proofs)

reward_variants.r1b_wsft: r_v = -NLL(p_v, typed_target(wsft row)) + lambda*consistency_v; typed_target maps SoftTarget/hard/insufficient to full label distribution including U

shared_frame.advantage: GRPO group-relative (r - mean)/(std + eps) within the 8 variants
shared_frame.kl_anchor: beta=0.05 KL to starting adapter e465 distributions

decomposability.conclusion: the cross-variant consistency signal is not expressible as any per-item gold loss; this is the legitimate RL-shaped component that the stopped pure-gold-reward route lacked

proofs_executed.honest_note: E[R] has a closed form for both variants, so an exact-gradient surrogate (consistency-regularized typed distillation over 8 forwards) strictly dominates sampled GRPO in variance; sampled GRPO keeps KL anchor and clipping as step-size control

pilot_forms.r1b_b0_legacy: zero trainer change: legacy4 1168 rows as plain WSFT data via scripts.train_s1 (tests augmentation component alone)
pilot_forms.r1b_wsft_exact: exact-gradient: sum over items of [NLL(p_v, typed_target) + lambda*(1-<p_v, mean_other>)]/N + beta*KL; group-batched, 40 items x 8 forwards fits 240s
pilot_forms.r1b_grpo_sampled: same groups, REINFORCE with group-relative advantages + KL anchor + clip 0.2; same expected objective as exact form
pilot_forms.trainer_delta: shared by exact/sampled: group batch construction, cached p_init second forward, ~60 lines loss wiring; documented, not implemented

gate_preregistered.pass: video150 >= 121/150 OR relation/existence subgroups >= +3pp, AND DEV50 no regression (>1 item drop stops)
gate_preregistered.extra: if B0 (augmentation-only) matches arm1w within 0.5pt, augmentation has no credit; consistency signal judged only on exact/sampled arms

priority_recommendation.within_r1b: R1-B-wsft > R1-B-gold (wsft shares B1+WSFT data at zero extra cost and carries the calibrated-typed paradigm)
priority_recommendation.versus_b1_arm2: B1 arm-2 twin coupling first if window fits only one: it targets the located relation/existence error cluster directly, while permutation consistency targets surface-perturbation robustness that measured evidence (frontier report I10) says does not overlap the error structure; R1-B-wsft as the next slot, R1-B-gold last
